description: What G7 (detection) requires of every input the VDR build reads: present, well-formed and, where the source dates itself, no older than max_age_hours. Read by scripts/detection-gate.py, which fails closed on a missing or invalid file. Each feed's mode (block or detect-and-recover) is in gate-modes.json under detection.<feed>. Each feed's platform says whether it depends on a cloud provider: aws feeds are fetched by scripts/fetch-aws-feeds.sh and reach the VDR only through scripts/aws-findings-adapter.py; any feeds work on any platform.
rationale: KEV: CISA releases the catalog on weekdays when entries change, not daily; 14 days tolerates quiet periods without missing a release cycle. EPSS: FIRST publishes daily; 3 days tolerates a missed publication. Grype DB: Anchore builds daily; 5 days matches Grype's own default maximum database age. The remaining feeds carry no source date and must simply be present and well-formed; Inspector and Access Analyzer are read live each run and must also report themselves on and scanning (added 2026-11-19); DAST's 14-day window is the builder's --zap-max-age-days.

epss.source_date: score_date in the file's header line
